text:
alex: Heads-up — hit a nasty reorder when testing streaming in the mobile sample app. visibility/tab-hide triggers fetch abort and the client sometimes emits fragments out of order.
priya: Ugh. Do you have a tiny repro or logs?
alex: Yep. Minimal network trace attached:
```
-- chunk A --
data: {"id":1, "text":"hello"

-- chunk B --
data: {"id":1, "text":" world"}
```
But the client processed B before the trailing part of A, resulting in broken JSON parse.
sam: Are you using last-event-id or resume tokens? Any auth refreshes in flight?
alex: We use resume-token flow + short-lived auth token. Repro needs an auth refresh during reconnect. If the Authorization header flips while parse state exists, tokenizer state gets reset.
priya: That sounds like a race: abort -> reconnect with fresh auth -> new connection's chunks get merged with leftover buffer. Can you repro with a forced visibility change?
alex: Yes — repro steps: 1) start stream in mobile chrome; 2) trigger pagehide (or swipe away) which aborts fetch; 3) rotate auth (token refresh arrives); 4) restore tab -> client reconnects quickly and gets fragments interleaved.
jordan: I saw something similar on iOS webview where XHR abort didn't fully clear internal stream buffers, got duplicate final-token. Might be platform differences.
priya: Two ideas: 1) hold auth swap until parser indicates closed/idle; 2) attach a small sequence header to each chunk on runtime side so client can detect out-of-order fragments and reassemble. Which is easier short-term?
sam: For a quick DX fix, add a tiny backoff on reconnect after visibilitychanges (100–300ms) and flush parser state on abort. Longer-term, add chunk-seq header. Also add a unit test into sample-apps.
alex: I'll open a PR with: harness that simulates pagehide + token rotate, parser flush on abort, and an e2e against staging runtime. Will include a small patch to keep old auth valid for 1s after refresh (config flag).
priya: Please include logs and the exact sniffed bytes (so we can match runtime-level behavior). Also add a note in devex docs about visibility aborts and recommended reconnection policy.
ci-bot: CI queued for branch sse/repro-visibility-abort — runs sample-app tests on staging.
jordan: One more: add a debug flag that emits chunk-seq as :seq=N in data lines to help in future debugging.
alex: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
